-- Copyright (c) 2019 Digital Asset (Switzerland) GmbH and/or its affiliates. All rights reserved.
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

module CrowdFunding where

import Iou

template Campaign
  with
    originator : Party
    name : Text
    description : Text
    backers : [Party]
    ious : [ContractId Iou]
    raised : Decimal
    deadline : Time
    threshold : Decimal
  where
    signatory originator
    signatory backers

    controller originator can
      Invite : ContractId BackerInvite
        with backer : Party
        do
          create BackerInvite with project = this; backer
      Claim : [ContractId Iou]
        do
          now <- getTime
          assertMsg "Can only claim after deadline" $ now >= deadline
          assertMsg "Can only claim if raised more than threshold" $ raised >= threshold
          unlockedIous <- mapA (\i -> exercise i Unlock) ious
          mapA (\i -> exercise i Transfer with newOwner = originator) unlockedIous

    choice Pledge : ContractId Campaign
      with
        backer : Party
        iouId : ContractId Iou
      controller backer
      do
        now <- getTime
        assertMsg "Pledges can only happen before the deadline" $ now < deadline
        assert $ elem backer backers
        iou <- fetch iouId
        assert $ iou.amount > 0.0
        lockedIou <- exercise iouId Lock with newLocker = originator
        create this with ious = lockedIou :: ious; raised = raised + iou.amount

    choice Reclaim : [ContractId Iou]
      with backer : Party
      controller backer
      do
        now <- getTime
        assert $ elem backer backers
        assertMsg "Can only reclaim after deadline" $ now >= deadline
        assertMsg "Can only reclaim if raised less than threshold" $ raised < threshold
        mapA (\i -> exercise i Unlock) ious

template BackerInvite
  with
    project : Campaign
    backer : Party
  where
    signatory project.originator, project.backers
    controller backer can
      Accept : ContractId Campaign
        do
          create project with backers = backer :: project.backers
-- Copyright (c) 2019 Digital Asset (Switzerland) GmbH and/or its affiliates. All rights reserved.
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

module Iou where

template Iou
  with
    issuer : Party
    owner : Party
    locker : Party
    amount : Decimal
    currency : Text
  where
    signatory issuer

    controller owner can
      Transfer : ContractId Iou
        with newOwner : Party
        do
          assert $ owner == locker
          create this with owner = newOwner; locker = newOwner
      Lock : ContractId Iou
        with newLocker : Party
        do
          assert $ owner == locker
          create this with locker = newLocker

    controller locker can
      Unlock : ContractId Iou
        do
          assert $ owner /= locker
          create this with locker = owner

*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: daml/Test.daml
@@
+module Test where
+
+import CrowdFunding
+import Iou
+import Daml.Script
+import DA.Time (addRelTime, seconds)
+
+makeCampaign : Party -> [Party] -> Time -> Decimal -> Script (ContractId Campaign)
+makeCampaign originator backers deadline threshold =
+  submit (originator :: backers) do
+    create Campaign with
+      originator
+      name = \"Garden\"
+      description = \"Community garden\"
+      backers
+      ious = []
+      raised = 0.0
+      deadline
+      threshold
+
+makeIou : Party -> Party -> Decimal -> Script (ContractId Iou)
+makeIou issuer owner amount =
+  submit issuer do
+    create Iou with issuer; owner; locker = owner; amount; currency = \"USD\"
+
+iouChoices : Script ()
+iouChoices = do
+  issuer <- allocateParty \"issuer\"
+  alice <- allocateParty \"alice\"
+  bob <- allocateParty \"bob\"
+  iou <- makeIou issuer alice 7.0
+  transferred <- submit alice do exercise iou Transfer with newOwner = bob
+  transferResult <- submit issuer do fetch transferred
+  assert (transferResult.owner == bob && transferResult.locker == bob)
+  submitMustFail alice do exercise transferred Lock with newLocker = alice
+  locked <- submit bob do exercise transferred Lock with newLocker = alice
+  lockedResult <- submit issuer do fetch locked
+  assert (lockedResult.owner == bob && lockedResult.locker == alice)
+  submitMustFail bob do exercise locked Transfer with newOwner = alice
+  submitMustFail bob do exercise locked Lock with newLocker = issuer
+  submitMustFail bob do exercise locked Unlock
+  unlocked <- submit alice do exercise locked Unlock
+  unlockedResult <- submit issuer do fetch unlocked
+  assert (unlockedResult.owner == bob && unlockedResult.locker == bob)
+  submitMustFail alice do exercise unlocked Unlock
+  final <- submit bob do exercise unlocked Transfer with newOwner = alice
+  finalResult <- submit issuer do fetch final
+  assert (finalResult.owner == alice && finalResult.locker == alice)
+
+invitationAndPledges : Script ()
+invitationAndPledges = do
+  originator <- allocateParty \"originator\"
+  issuer <- allocateParty \"issuer\"
+  alice <- allocateParty \"alice\"
+  bob <- allocateParty \"bob\"
+  stranger <- allocateParty \"stranger\"
+  start <- getTime
+  let deadline = addRelTime start (seconds 60)
+  campaign <- makeCampaign originator [] deadline 10.0
+  aliceIou <- makeIou issuer alice 4.0
+  submitMustFail alice do exercise campaign Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = aliceIou
+  invitation <- submit originator do exercise campaign Invite with backer = alice
+  submitMustFail bob do exercise invitation Accept
+  invited <- submit alice do exercise invitation Accept
+  invitedData <- submit originator do fetch invited
+  assert (invitedData.backers == [alice] && invitedData.raised == 0.0 && invitedData.ious == [])
+  submitMustFail stranger do exercise invited Pledge with backer = stranger; iouId = aliceIou
+  submitMustFail bob do exercise invited Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = aliceIou
+  emptyIou <- makeIou issuer alice 0.0
+  negativeIou <- makeIou issuer alice (-1.0)
+  submitMustFail alice do exercise invited Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = emptyIou
+  submitMustFail alice do exercise invited Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = negativeIou
+  pledged <- submit alice do exercise invited Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = aliceIou
+  pledgeData <- submit originator do fetch pledged
+  assert (pledgeData.raised == 4.0 && length pledgeData.ious == 1 && pledgeData.backers == [alice])
+  locked <- submit issuer do fetch (head pledgeData.ious)
+  assert (locked.owner == alice && locked.locker == originator && locked.amount == 4.0)
+  submitMustFail alice do exercise pledged Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = aliceIou
+  bobInvitation <- submit originator do exercise pledged Invite with backer = bob
+  both <- submit bob do exercise bobInvitation Accept
+  bothData <- submit originator do fetch both
+  assert (bothData.backers == [bob, alice] && bothData.ious == pledgeData.ious && bothData.raised == 4.0)
+  bobIou <- makeIou issuer bob 6.0
+  fullyPledged <- submit bob do exercise both Pledge with backer = bob; iouId = bobIou
+  finalData <- submit originator do fetch fullyPledged
+  assert (finalData.raised == 10.0 && length finalData.ious == 2)
+  submitMustFail originator do exercise fullyPledged Claim
+  submitMustFail alice do exercise fullyPledged Reclaim with backer = alice
+  setTime deadline
+  submitMustFail alice do exercise fullyPledged Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = emptyIou
+  submitMustFail alice do exercise fullyPledged Reclaim with backer = alice
+  claimed <- submit originator do exercise fullyPledged Claim
+  assert (length claimed == 2)
+  first <- submit issuer do fetch (head claimed)
+  second <- submit issuer do fetch (head (tail claimed))
+  assert (first.owner == originator && first.locker == originator && first.amount == 6.0)
+  assert (second.owner == originator && second.locker == originator && second.amount == 4.0)
+
+reclaimBelowThreshold : Script ()
+reclaimBelowThreshold = do
+  originator <- allocateParty \"originator\"
+  issuer <- allocateParty \"issuer\"
+  alice <- allocateParty \"alice\"
+  bob <- allocateParty \"bob\"
+  start <- getTime
+  let deadline = addRelTime start (seconds 60)
+  campaign <- makeCampaign originator [alice, bob] deadline 10.0
+  aliceIou <- makeIou issuer alice 3.0
+  bobIou <- makeIou issuer bob 2.0
+  once <- submit alice do exercise campaign Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = aliceIou
+  twice <- submit bob do exercise once Pledge with backer = bob; iouId = bobIou
+  submitMustFail originator do exercise twice Claim
+  submitMustFail alice do exercise twice Reclaim with backer = alice
+  setTime deadline
+  submitMustFail originator do exercise twice Claim
+  submitMustFail originator do exercise twice Reclaim with backer = alice
+  returned <- submit alice do exercise twice Reclaim with backer = alice
+  assert (length returned == 2)
+  first <- submit issuer do fetch (head returned)
+  second <- submit issuer do fetch (head (tail returned))
+  assert (first.owner == bob && first.locker == bob && first.amount == 2.0)
+  assert (second.owner == alice && second.locker == alice && second.amount == 3.0)
+  submitMustFail bob do exercise twice Reclaim with backer = bob
+
+emptyCampaignBoundaries : Script ()
+emptyCampaignBoundaries = do
+  originator <- allocateParty \"originator\"
+  alice <- allocateParty \"alice\"
+  start <- getTime
+  let deadline = addRelTime start (seconds 60)
+  successful <- makeCampaign originator [alice] deadline 0.0
+  unsuccessful <- makeCampaign originator [alice] deadline 1.0
+  submitMustFail originator do exercise successful Claim
+  setTime deadline
+  submitMustFail alice do exercise successful Reclaim with backer = alice
+  submitMustFail originator do exercise unsuccessful Claim
+  claimed <- submit originator do exercise successful Claim
+  assert (claimed == [])
+  reclaimed <- submit alice do exercise unsuccessful Reclaim with backer = alice
+  assert (reclaimed == [])
*** End Patch

/usr/bin/bash -lc "cat > crowd-funding/daml/Test.daml <<'EOF'
module Test where

import CrowdFunding
import Iou
import Daml.Script
import DA.Time (addRelTime, seconds)

makeCampaign : Party -> [Party] -> Time -> Decimal -> Script (ContractId Campaign)
makeCampaign originator backers deadline threshold =
  submit (originator :: backers) do
    create Campaign with
      originator; name = \"Garden\"; description = \"Community garden\"
      backers; ious = []; raised = 0.0; deadline; threshold

makeIou : Party -> Party -> Decimal -> Script (ContractId Iou)
makeIou issuer owner amount =
  submit issuer do
    create Iou with issuer; owner; locker = owner; amount; currency = \"USD\"

iouChoices : Script ()
iouChoices = do
  issuer <- allocateParty \"issuer\"
  alice <- allocateParty \"alice\"
  bob <- allocateParty \"bob\"
  iou <- makeIou issuer alice 7.0
  transferred <- submit alice do exercise iou Transfer with newOwner = bob
  transferResult <- submit issuer do fetch transferred
  assert (transferResult.owner == bob && transferResult.locker == bob)
  submitMustFail alice do exercise transferred Lock with newLocker = alice
  locked <- submit bob do exercise transferred Lock with newLocker = alice
  lockedResult <- submit issuer do fetch locked
  assert (lockedResult.owner == bob && lockedResult.locker == alice)
  submitMustFail bob do exercise locked Transfer with newOwner = alice
  submitMustFail bob do exercise locked Lock with newLocker = issuer
  submitMustFail bob do exercise locked Unlock
  unlocked <- submit alice do exercise locked Unlock
  unlockedResult <- submit issuer do fetch unlocked
  assert (unlockedResult.owner == bob && unlockedResult.locker == bob)
  submitMustFail alice do exercise unlocked Unlock
  final <- submit bob do exercise unlocked Transfer with newOwner = alice
  finalResult <- submit issuer do fetch final
  assert (finalResult.owner == alice && finalResult.locker == alice)

invitationAndPledges : Script ()
invitationAndPledges = do
  originator <- allocateParty \"originator\"
  issuer <- allocateParty \"issuer\"
  alice <- allocateParty \"alice\"
  bob <- allocateParty \"bob\"
  stranger <- allocateParty \"stranger\"
  start <- getTime
  let deadline = addRelTime start (seconds 60)
  campaign <- makeCampaign originator [] deadline 10.0
  aliceIou <- makeIou issuer alice 4.0
  submitMustFail alice do exercise campaign Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = aliceIou
  invitation <- submit originator do exercise campaign Invite with backer = alice
  submitMustFail bob do exercise invitation Accept
  invited <- submit alice do exercise invitation Accept
  invitedData <- submit originator do fetch invited
  assert (invitedData.backers == [alice] && invitedData.raised == 0.0 && invitedData.ious == [])
  submitMustFail stranger do exercise invited Pledge with backer = stranger; iouId = aliceIou
  submitMustFail bob do exercise invited Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = aliceIou
  emptyIou <- makeIou issuer alice 0.0
  negativeIou <- makeIou issuer alice (-1.0)
  submitMustFail alice do exercise invited Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = emptyIou
  submitMustFail alice do exercise invited Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = negativeIou
  pledged <- submit alice do exercise invited Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = aliceIou
  pledgeData <- submit originator do fetch pledged
  assert (pledgeData.raised == 4.0 && length pledgeData.ious == 1 && pledgeData.backers == [alice])
  locked <- submit issuer do fetch (head pledgeData.ious)
  assert (locked.owner == alice && locked.locker == originator && locked.amount == 4.0)
  submitMustFail alice do exercise pledged Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = aliceIou
  bobInvitation <- submit originator do exercise pledged Invite with backer = bob
  both <- submit bob do exercise bobInvitation Accept
  bothData <- submit originator do fetch both
  assert (bothData.backers == [bob, alice] && bothData.ious == pledgeData.ious && bothData.raised == 4.0)
  bobIou <- makeIou issuer bob 6.0
  fullyPledged <- submit bob do exercise both Pledge with backer = bob; iouId = bobIou
  finalData <- submit originator do fetch fullyPledged
  assert (finalData.raised == 10.0 && length finalData.ious == 2)
  submitMustFail originator do exercise fullyPledged Claim
  submitMustFail alice do exercise fullyPledged Reclaim with backer = alice
  setTime deadline
  submitMustFail alice do exercise fullyPledged Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = emptyIou
  submitMustFail alice do exercise fullyPledged Reclaim with backer = alice
  claimed <- submit originator do exercise fullyPledged Claim
  assert (length claimed == 2)
  first <- submit issuer do fetch (head claimed)
  second <- submit issuer do fetch (head (tail claimed))
  assert (first.owner == originator && first.locker == originator && first.amount == 6.0)
  assert (second.owner == originator && second.locker == originator && second.amount == 4.0)

reclaimBelowThreshold : Script ()
reclaimBelowThreshold = do
  originator <- allocateParty \"originator\"
  issuer <- allocateParty \"issuer\"
  alice <- allocateParty \"alice\"
  bob <- allocateParty \"bob\"
  start <- getTime
  let deadline = addRelTime start (seconds 60)
  campaign <- makeCampaign originator [alice, bob] deadline 10.0
  aliceIou <- makeIou issuer alice 3.0
  bobIou <- makeIou issuer bob 2.0
  once <- submit alice do exercise campaign Pledge with backer = alice; iouId = aliceIou
  twice <- submit bob do exercise once Pledge with backer = bob; iouId = bobIou
  submitMustFail originator do exercise twice Claim
  submitMustFail alice do exercise twice Reclaim with backer = alice
  setTime deadline
  submitMustFail originator do exercise twice Claim
  submitMustFail originator do exercise twice Reclaim with backer = alice
  returned <- submit alice do exercise twice Reclaim with backer = alice
  assert (length returned == 2)
  first <- submit issuer do fetch (head returned)
  second <- submit issuer do fetch (head (tail returned))
  assert (first.owner == bob && first.locker == bob && first.amount == 2.0)
  assert (second.owner == alice && second.locker == alice && second.amount == 3.0)
  submitMustFail bob do exercise twice Reclaim with backer = bob

emptyCampaignBoundaries : Script ()
emptyCampaignBoundaries = do
  originator <- allocateParty \"originator\"
  alice <- allocateParty \"alice\"
  start <- getTime
  let deadline = addRelTime start (seconds 60)
  successful <- makeCampaign originator [alice] deadline 0.0
  unsuccessful <- makeCampaign originator [alice] deadline 1.0
  submitMustFail originator do exercise successful Claim
  setTime deadline
  submitMustFail alice do exercise successful Reclaim with backer = alice
  submitMustFail originator do exercise unsuccessful Claim
  claimed <- submit originator do exercise successful Claim
  assert (claimed == [])
  reclaimed <- submit alice do exercise unsuccessful Reclaim with backer = alice
  assert (reclaimed == [])
EOF
cd crowd-funding && daml test"

  transferResult <- submit issuer do fetch transferred

  locked <- submit bob do exercise transferred Lock with newLocker = alice
  lockedResult <- submit issuer do fetch locked
  assert (lockedResult.owner == bob && lockedResult.locker == alice)
  submitMustFail bob do exercise locked Transfer with newOwner = alice
  submitMustFail bob do exercise locked Lock with newLocker = issuer
  submitMustFail bob do exercise locked Unlock
  unlocked <- submit alice do exercise locked Unlock
  unlockedResult <- submit issuer do fetch unlocked
  assert (unlockedResult.owner == bob && unlockedResult.locker == bob)
  submitMustFail alice do exercise unlocked Unlock
  final <- submit bob do exercise unlocked Transfer with newOwner = alice
  finalResult <- submit issuer do fetch final
  assert (finalResult.owner == alice && finalResult.locker == alice)

  invitation <- submit originator do exercise campaign Invite with backer = alice
  submitMustFail bob do exercise invitation Accept
  invited <- submit alice do exercise invitation Accept
  invitedData <- submit originator do fetch invited

s=s.replace('  start <- getTime\\n  let deadline = addRelTime start (seconds 60)\\n  campaign <- makeCampaign originator [alice, bob] deadline 10.0', '  stranger <- allocateParty \"stranger\"\\n  start <- getTime\\n  let deadline = addRelTime start (seconds 60)\\n  campaign <- makeCampaign originator [alice, bob] deadline 10.0')

claimAboveThreshold : Script ()

  result <- mapA (readIou issuer) claimed
  assert (map (\\\\iou -> (iou.owner, iou.locker, iou.amount)) result == [(originator, originator, 4.0), (originator, originator, 3.0)])
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
